attchmntText: Allcargo Global Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 15, 2026, titled "Press release on unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Allcargo Global Limited submitted its press release on unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. On a consolidated basis, Q2 FY27 revenue stood at 4320 crore, registering a 23% sequential growth. EBITDA increased to 122 crore, compared with 33 crore in Q1 FY27, registering a sequential growth of 270%. The company reported a Profit After Tax of 32 crore in Q2 FY27, compared with a loss of 28 crore in Q1 FY27. Gross profit increased 14% QoQ to 837 crore. LCL volumes grew 3% over the previous quarter, while FCL and Air volumes increased by 1% and 16%, respectively. The company reported a PBT of 62 crore during Q2FY27. This intimation is being uploaded on the Company’s website.

attchmntText: Allcargo Global Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Allcargo Global Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter ended September 2026, ahead of an earnings conference call on November 17, 2026. Revenue for Q2FY27 was Rs. 4,320 crores, up 27% year-on-year. Gross profit stood at Rs. 837 crores, a 21% increase year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs. 32 crores, compared to a loss in the prior year period. EBITDA rose to Rs. 122 crores, up 229% year-on-year. LCL volume declined 5.7% year-on-year, while FCL volume fell 12% and air volume dropped 10%. Net debt as of September 2026 was Rs. 587 crores. The company cited capacity constraints and peak season volumes as factors keeping freight rates elevated.

attchmntText: Allcargo Global Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Allcargo Global Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. Statutory auditors S.R. Batliboi & Associates LLP issued unmodified limited review reports. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, income from operations was 681 Crores. Total income was 682 Crores. Total expenses were 674 Crores. Profit before tax was 8 Crores. Profit after tax was 6 Crores. Earnings per share were 0.06 Rupees. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, income from operations was 1,202 Crores. Total income was 1,207 Crores. Total expenses were 1,197 Crores. Profit before tax was 10 Crores. Profit after tax was 6 Crores. Earnings per share were 0.06 Rupees. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 1,150 Crores. Paid-up equity share capital was 197 Crores.
